title: Chapter 5: Aladdin and the Wonderful Lamp - The Magic Ring
chineseTitle: 第 5 章：阿拉丁与神灯手环

paragraphs.en: Scheherazade next wove the magical tale of Aladdin, a poor boy living in China. An evil magician from North Africa pretended to be Aladdin's uncle and led him to a secret underground cave. Giving Aladdin a magic ring for protection, the sorcerer ordered him to retrieve an old brass oil lamp. But when Aladdin refused to hand over the lamp before climbing out, the angry magician sealed the cave.
paragraphs.zh: 雪赫拉查德接下来编织了阿拉丁的神奇故事，一个生活在中国贫穷男孩。一个来自北非的邪恶巫师假装是阿拉丁的叔叔，带他来到了一个秘密地下山洞。给了阿拉丁一枚魔法手环作为保护，巫师命令他取回一盏旧黄铜油灯。但当阿拉丁在爬出来前拒绝交出油灯时，愤怒的巫师封死了山洞。

paragraphs.en: Trapped in the dark, Aladdin accidentally rubbed the magic ring. A giant Genie of the Ring appeared, bellowing: 'I am the slave of the ring! What is your command?' The Genie transported Aladdin safely home to his mother.
paragraphs.zh: 被困在黑暗中，阿拉丁意外擦拭了魔法手环。一个巨大的手环精灵出现了，咆哮道：“我是手环的奴隶！您有什么指令？”精灵把阿拉丁安全传送回到了他母亲身边。
